test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Time has made the face

A. and it remains so

B. that is being put on it

C. in spite of the lipstick

D. of my country stark, chastened and sad

S6. by the hand of the spiritual half-castes.
solution:
The correct answer is "**DACB.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• S1 and S6 are already in the correct order, so we need to arrange the remaining sentences in between them.
 
• Sentence D ("of my country stark, chastened and sad") provides the subject of the paragraph, so it will come after sentence S1.
 
• Further, the sentence A explains how the face of the country remains sad and chastened.
 
• We can first identify that sentence C ("in spite of the lipstick that is being put on it") refers to some attempt to cover up or hide the true state of the country's face.
 
• Therefore, sentence B ("that is being put on it") should come after sentence C to provide context to covering the true face of the country.
 
• **Thus, starting from statement D starts with describing the real state of the country and statement B concludes with how the real state is covered.**
 
• **A metaphor is used by stating that lipstick is used to cover the true face of the country.**
 
• Thus, the correct order of the given statements will be "DACB."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (CBDA) **- Incorrect order where sentence C and B are swapped, leading to a confusing and disjointed paragraph.
 
• **Option 2 (CADB) -** Incorrect order where sentence C is placed at the beginning, disrupting the flow and coherence of the paragraph.
 
• **Option 4 (CDAB) -** Incorrect order where sentence D and A are swapped, leading to a weak conclusion and lack of closure.
